hero.line1: People groups around the world participate in Church-Based Bible Translation.

stories.heading: Zeme
stories.body: Suppose you’re a church leader in a large people group. You’ve noticed a problem: though the church has existed in your people group for over 100 years…

stories.heading: Mblego
stories.body: “I am so burdened for my people.” These are the words of Ahmed*, a Sudanese man who recently became a follower of Jesus.

stories.heading: Tavretsi and Khateni
stories.body: Deep in a mountainous Eurasian country, two people groups do not have a translation of the Bible in their language.

stories.heading: Ruska Roma
stories.body: Imagine the following scenario. You’ve grown up in the church and been a member your entire life—indeed, it has been part of your people’s history…

stories.heading: Yuracani and Quipa
stories.body: South America is home to over 900 people groups. Many of them are unreached by the gospel, living in dense jungles and involved in uneasy relationships with the outside world.

comingSoon.heading: Submit your impact story!
comingSoon.body: Every story shows how God is working through His church to make His Word known. Want to see your story featured? Send us an email at: churchbased.bible@unfoldingword.org.
